el.Tres líneas de obra, una misma mano hipe: Three lines of work, one hyperrealist hand: black-and-white pop portraits, bodies that share the page with comics, and figurative scenes where glass and skin look real.
el.Óleos sobre lienzo, piezas únicas firmad: Oil on canvas, unique signed pieces.
el.Una pintura pensada para vos: tu objeto,: A painting made just for you: your object, your pet, your idea.
el.Obra para casas, oficinas y proyectos de: Art for homes, offices and interior design projects. International shipping.
el.Íconos de la música y la cultura en blan: Icons of music and culture in black and white: Lenny Kravitz, Cher, Frida Kahlo, Amy Winehouse, Elton John. Pure contrast, planes of gray and a presence that fills the wall.
el.El cuerpo hiperrealista se cruza con viñ: The hyperrealist body meets comic-book panels: Vendetta, Deadpool, Spider-Man and the lingerie series she presented at CHROMA 2025, Miami Art Week.
el.La fuerza silenciosa del cuerpo femenino: The quiet strength of the female body in introspective scenes, and everyday objects —soda siphons, jars, cereal boxes— where glass and metal look real.
Made to live in a space.
I have a degree in Interior Design. That's why every piece also considers the place where it will live: the light, the wall, the scale.
el.Trabajo con particulares, arquitectos e: I work with private clients, architects and interior designers. Shipping nationwide and internationally.

el.Soy pintora figurativa argentina y licen: I am an Argentine figurative painter with a degree in Interior Design. My work explores the quiet strength of the female body through introspective scenes in which certain symbols —liquids, objects or gestures— turn the figure into an emotional territory.
el.Me formé en Caracas, donde viví varios a: I trained in Caracas, where I lived for several years, with Patrizia Rizzo (drawing, color and composition) and studied photography with Roberto Mata. Back in Buenos Aires, I took Omar Ortiz's workshop on hyperrealism in skin and the human figure, and studied art history, drawing and classical painting with Ricardo Celma.
el.“Admiro profundamente a la mujer: por es: “I deeply admire women, which is why much of my work is dedicated to them.”
